info.bio: Si existe una base musical que haya servido de inspiración a toda la oleada del Hardcore Punk del momento sin duda son los Descendents; con más de 45 años de vida han sabido combinar una serie de sonidos que rozan el límite entre el pop y el punk y han sido coronados como los reyes en este estilo, posteriormente imitado pero nunca superado hasta el momento por nombres que han sacado una tajada económicamente más rentable en un par de años que los propios Descendents en toda su carrera.

scenes.name: Hardcore
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: El punk como «violento, rápido y ruidoso» tarda en conquistar EE UU, pero cuando lo hace el hardcore se convierte durante dos décadas en el idioma nacional de millones de chavales. Misfits y el «scum-rock»; el crossover punk-metal (Suicidal Tendencies, Corrosion Of Conformity, Agnostic Front); Mission Of Burma en Boston. Washington: Bad Brains (reggae, funk y metal diez años por delante), Minor Threat (el «straight-edge») y Rites Of Spring, inventores del emo-core. San Francisco: Dead Kennedys de Jello Biafra, D.R.I. (thrash antes que Metallica), Flipper. Los «beach punks» de Los Ángeles: Germs, X, Black Flag (Damaged), Descendents, Gun Club (Fire Of Love), Bad Religion. El jazz-core de Minutemen y Saccharine Trust; en el Medio Oeste, Husker Du y Replacements cambian el hardcore para siempre; en Chicago, Naked Raygun y Big Black de Steve Albini; en Europa, The Ex y los italianos CCCP.

podcast.title: California Origins
podcast.body: This band originated from California, a key region in the development of skate punk culture. "The Descendants, California again."

podcast.title: Grizzled Veteran Participant
podcast.body: The Descendents were among the seasoned acts who participated in the Warped Tour, highlighting the festival's ability to attract established artists. "We also have Joan Jett in the descendants."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Influence on Major Artists
podcast.body: The Descendents are cited among several California hardcore bands that were very important to the musical education of figures like Eddie Vedder and Dave Grohl. "Talk to Eddie Vetter or Dave Grohl, and they'll tell you how some of these bands were really, really important to their musical education."

podcast.title: Origin and Evolution to Melody
podcast.body: Hailing from Manhattan Beach in the southwest part of Los Angeles, The Descendents initially played very hardcore music but eventually evolved into a unique sound. Their distinctiveness stemmed from incorporating more melody into their music, a strategy that helped them stand out from the crowd. "They were very hardcore at first, but eventually evolved into something unique."
